patterns: ^%{IP:client_ip} - (?:%{DATA:remote_user}|-) \[%{HTTPDATE:nginx_time}\] "%{WORD:method} %{DATA:path} HTTP/%{NUMBER:http_version}" %{INT:status:int} %{INT:bytes:int} "%{DATA:referrer}" "%{DATA:user_agent}" "%{DATA:x_forwarded_for}" host="%{DATA:host}" upstream="%{DATA:upstream_addr}" upstream_status="%{DATA:upstream_status}" upstream_rt="%{DATA:_upstream_rt}" rt=%{NUMBER:request_time:float}
grok.description: nginx 'main' log_format: combined + XFF, then (since 2026-11) a host/upstream/timing key="value" tail. The second pattern keeps older lines parsing.

script.source: if (ctx._upstream_rt != null) { double t = 0; boolean any = false; for (String part : /[,:]/.split(ctx._upstream_rt)) { String v = part.trim(); if (v.length() > 0 && v != '-') { try { t += Double.parseDouble(v); any = true; } catch (NumberFormatException e) {} } } if (any) { ctx.upstream_response_time = (float) t; } ctx.remove('_upstream_rt'); } for (String f : ['upstream_addr', 'upstream_status', 'host']) { if (ctx[f] == '-' || ctx[f] == '') { ctx.remove(f); } }
script.description: nginx: upstream_response_time = sum of the upstream tries ('0.001, 0.003'; '-' = none), and drop '-' placeholders so exists-queries mean something

gunicorn — startup messages + access log (combined format from --access-logfile=-)

script.source: def m1=/Failed=(\d+)/.matcher(ctx.extras); if(m1.find()){ ctx.wt_failed=Integer.parseInt(m1.group(1)); } def m2=/Updated=(\d+)/.matcher(ctx.extras); if(m2.find()){ ctx.wt_updated=Integer.parseInt(m2.group(1)); } def m3=/Scanned=(\d+)/.matcher(ctx.extras); if(m3.find()){ ctx.wt_scanned=Integer.parseInt(m3.group(1)); }
script.description: Parse Failed=N / Updated=N / Scanned=N from watchtower's extras into integer fields for charting

script.source: if (ctx._osd.statusCode != null) { ctx.status = ctx._osd.statusCode; } if (ctx._osd.req != null) { if (ctx._osd.req.url != null) { ctx.path = ctx._osd.req.url; } if (ctx._osd.req.method != null) { ctx.method = ctx._osd.req.method.toUpperCase(); } } if (ctx._osd.message != null) { ctx.msg = ctx._osd.message; } else if (ctx._osd.req != null && ctx._osd.req.url != null) { ctx.msg = (ctx._osd.method == null ? '' : ctx._osd.method.toUpperCase()) + ' ' + ctx._osd.req.url + (ctx._osd.statusCode == null ? '' : ' -> ' + ctx._osd.statusCode); } if (ctx._osd.type == 'error') { ctx.level = 'ERROR'; } else { ctx.level = 'INFO'; }

grok.description: cookbook + personal-website (Nginx-served static, combined log format)
Seafile logs — bracketed timestamp variant + plain-line variant for log lines without timestamp prefix
Fluent Bit's own log format: [time] [level] message
fail2ban's own log (/var/log/fail2ban.log via a Fluent Bit tail input): time logger [pid]: LEVEL [jail] message

script.source: def m = /^(Restore Ban|Ban|Unban|Found|Ignore) ([0-9a-fA-F:.]+)/.matcher(ctx.msg); if (m.find()) { String a = m.group(1); String ip = m.group(2); if (ip ==~ /^[0-9]{1,3}(\.[0-9]{1,3}){3}$/ || ip.contains(':')) { ctx.client_ip = ip; } if (a == 'Ban') { ctx.event_type = 'fail2ban_ban'; } else if (a == 'Unban') { ctx.event_type = 'fail2ban_unban'; } else if (a == 'Restore Ban') { ctx.event_type = 'fail2ban_restore'; } else if (a == 'Found') { ctx.event_type = 'fail2ban_found'; } else { ctx.event_type = 'fail2ban_ignore'; } }
script.description: fail2ban events: event_type fail2ban_ban / fail2ban_unban / fail2ban_restore (re-ban after a fail2ban restart, not a new ban) / fail2ban_found / fail2ban_ignore, client_ip

grok.description: Postgres log format for *-db containers — LOG is postgres-specific, mapped to INFO below. tallied-db (since 2026-11-25) adds 'host=%h user=%u db=%d ' to the prefix

script.if: ctx._pg_host != null || ctx.pg_user != null || ctx.pg_db != null
script.source: if (ctx._pg_host != null) { String h = ctx._pg_host; if (h ==~ /^[0-9]{1,3}(\.[0-9]{1,3}){3}$/ || (h.contains(':') && h ==~ /^[0-9a-fA-F:.]+$/)) { ctx.client_ip = h; } ctx.remove('_pg_host'); } if (ctx.pg_user != null && (ctx.pg_user == '' || ctx.pg_user == '[unknown]')) { ctx.remove('pg_user'); } if (ctx.pg_db != null && (ctx.pg_db == '' || ctx.pg_db == '[unknown]')) { ctx.remove('pg_db'); } if (ctx.msg != null) { String m = ctx.msg; if (m.startsWith('password authentication failed') || m.startsWith('no pg_hba.conf entry') || m.startsWith('pg_hba.conf rejects connection')) { ctx.event_type = 'pg_auth_failure'; } else if (m.startsWith('connection authorized')) { ctx.event_type = 'pg_connection_authorized'; } }
script.description: Postgres prefix fields: client_ip (only a real address; socket connections log host=[local]), pg_user, pg_db, and event_type pg_auth_failure / pg_connection_authorized for the fail2ban and tld_ login monitors

script.source: String p = ctx.path; int q = p.indexOf('?'); if (q >= 0) { p = p.substring(0, q); } if (!(p == '/health' || p == '/healthz' || p == '/api/health' || p == '/api/v1/health' || p.startsWith('/api/health/') || p.startsWith('/health/'))) { return; } String xff = ctx.x_forwarded_for == null ? '-' : ctx.x_forwarded_for.toString().trim(); String ua = ctx.user_agent == null ? '' : ctx.user_agent.toString(); String ip = ctx.client_ip == null ? '' : ctx.client_ip.toString(); boolean noXff = xff == '-' || xff == ''; boolean loopback = ip.startsWith('127.') || ip == '::1'; boolean lan = loopback || ip.startsWith('10.') || ip.startsWith('192.168.') || /^172\.(1[6-9]|2[0-9]|3[01])\./.matcher(ip).find(); boolean kuma = ua.startsWith('Uptime-Kuma') && (noXff || xff.startsWith('173.48.155.66')); boolean probeUa = /^(curl\/|Wget|Python-urllib|python-requests|Go-http-client|kube-probe)/.matcher(ua).find(); if (kuma || (noXff && loopback) || (ctx.container_name == 'nginx' && noXff && lan && probeUa)) { ctx.healthcheck = true; }
script.description: Tag genuine probe traffic (healthcheck:true): a health path AND one of: Uptime Kuma UA; a loopback client (Docker HEALTHCHECK inside the container); or, at nginx, a LAN client with no X-Forwarded-For and a probe UA (curl/wget/python). Internet scanners on /api/health (2026-11 audit) and requests nginx proxies to an app no longer count.

remove.description: Drop preserved copy after pipeline succeeds
